description: Figure 8(d) illustrates how accuracy (ACC) varies with co-occurrence number for several editing methods on Qwen2.5. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with major ticks at approximately \(10^{1}\), \(10^{2}\), and \(10^{3}\), spanning from about 10 to about 3000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 85 with ticks every 5 percentage points. Six solid lines with small circular markers are shown: Base (black) increases from about 64 at the lowest co-occurrence to about 71 at the highest; FT (blue) rises from about 66 to about 73; IKE (red) rises from about 67 to about 75; MEND (brown) rises from about 70 to about 79; MEMIT (purple) rises from about 69 to about 77; and ROME (green) rises from about 74 to about 83, with all series showing monotonic increases across the plotted x-values.
